title: The layout gets a core todo kind
why: o15 sends tasks a session catches to tracked files, but the layout has no todo kind, so each repo keeps its follow-ups somewhere different (q_max: specs/todo.md, with no layout key).
note: Ruling, Oct 26 (shiv, waiting page, o15 answer a): add a core 'todo' kind to lint/layout.json (docs/todo.md by default) with a legacy map entry per repo. Built: draft PR 656, head ef33b25, two Sonnet review rounds, clear; sent to the build advisor (6) Oct 27. The per-repo entries live in a new legacy-repos map keyed by GitHub name: q_max specs/todo.md, home and home-app records/; other repos get docs/todo.md. Port: yes, every repo reads the layout at its roll-out. Placed after o2 (triage, Oct 26).
